raw_segments.text: But as the sun was rising from the fair sea twenty-four into the firmament of heaven to
shed light on mortals and immortals, they reached Pylos, the city of Nelius.
Now the people of Pylos were gathered on the sea shore to offer sacrifice of black bulls
to Neptune Lord of the Earthquake.

As they were eating the inward meets twenty-five and burning the thigh bones on the embers,
in the name of Neptune, Telemachus and his crew arrived, furled their sails, brought
their ship to anchor, and went ashore.
